literal_meaning: কোল (lap/waist) + পাতলা (thin/shallow) – thin lap or shallow embrace
figurative_meaning_en: Not too close together, somewhat at a distance
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্ধুরা কোলপাতলা বসে গল্প করছিল, যাতে সবাই স্বাচ্ছন্দ্য বোধ করে।
পারিবারিক অনুষ্ঠানে অতিথিরা কোলপাতলা বসানো হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The friends were sitting at a comfortable distance, not too huddled, so everyone felt at ease.
In the family gathering, the guests were seated somewhat apart from each other.
history: The idiom draws from traditional Bengali seating customs in rural or semi-rural settings, often referenced in folk rhymes like 'কোলপাতলা ডাগরগুছি' which emphasize modest social spacing.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on personal space in informal gatherings.
